decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck includes cards like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to quickly develop a threatening board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of Goblin Bombardment provides reach and synergizes well with creature tokens created by cards like Ocelot Pride. The use of utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland helps disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional ways to push through damage and secure victory.

This Legacy Death & Taxes deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to disrupt opponents while applying pressure with aggro tactics. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Karakas, Wasteland, and Thoughtseize to control the board and slow down the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it features key equipment like Cloak and Dagger, Meteor Sword, and Aether Vial to enhance the creatures' abilities and make them even more difficult to deal with.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive elements to control the game and put pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a board presence with creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value in the form of blinking creatures and generating card advantage, further cementing the deck's versatility and potential to outmaneuver the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to apply pressure early in the game with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the game tempo by using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the right answers and threats. The deck also uses cards like Wasteland to disrupt opponents' mana base. Overall, this Aggro-UR Tempo deck is all about applying pressure, disrupting opponents, and maintaining control of the game tempo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler to generate card advantage and gain incremental advantages over time. The creatures in the deck, such as Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, provide additional threats and help to close out the game once the opponent's resources are sufficiently depleted. The mana base allows for consistent access to all three colors necessary for the deck's spells.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently generate mana through cards like Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond, in order to cast multiple spells in one turn. By chaining together spells like Dark Ritual, Burning Wish, and Gamble, the player can build up a storm count and eventually win the game with Tendrils of Agony. The deck also utilizes cards like Veil of Summer and Echo of Eons to protect its combo pieces and refill its hand. The flexibility of Burning Wish allows for access to a variety of win conditions from the sideboard.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Nethergoyf. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and keep the opponent on the back foot by efficiently using removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out. With a mix of disruption, card draw, and aggressive threats, the deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands to control the game, with various cards that allow for land manipulation and disruption. By using tools like Life from the Loam, Wasteland, Crop Rotation, and Urza's Saga, the player can disrupt their opponent's mana base while also ramping up their own resources. The inclusion of cards like Sphere of Resistance and Maze of Ith provide additional control elements, creating a strong defensive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield using powerful land-based control tools.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares while also creating card advantage and consistency with Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck's win conditions include Murktide Regent, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, and Quantum Riddler. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage and utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro - Death & Taxes deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while also applying pressure with creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition. The deck also includes powerful utility lands like Wasteland and Karakas to further control the game. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds versatility and additional value to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outpace opponents with efficient creatures and disruptive spells to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then utilizing cards like Reanimate, Shallow Grave, and Animate Dead to bring them back to the battlefield for a devastating combo finish. It also includes disruptive cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect the combo. The deck aims to win the game through powerful reanimation plays and overwhelming the opponent with big threats that can swing the game in its favor.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful card advantage engines in Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Meticulous Archive, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. It also includes disruptive cards like Stifle and Force of Will to maintain control over the game. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with strong card draw and control elements, while keeping the board clear and hindering the opponent's strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a prison-like control over the opponent's actions by utilizing powerful artifacts such as Karn, the Great Creator, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere. By restricting the opponent's ability to cast spells and activate abilities, this deck aims to slow down the game and eventually win through overwhelming card advantage and efficient mana ramping. The inclusion of cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Manifold Key further strengthens this control strategy, creating a formidable fortress that is difficult for the opponent to break through.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up card advantage and controlling the board. With a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent over time. By efficiently using cards like Quantum Riddler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage, while also utilizing powerful disruption tools like Stifle and Force of Will, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a long game.

The key concept of this deck is to gain control of the game by utilizing powerful control cards such as Swords to Plowshares, Force of Will, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also generating card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. It includes a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw to maintain dominance over the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Back to Basics further solidify the control aspect of the deck, allowing it to dictate the pace of the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It uses cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down opponents and cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for equipment to enhance its creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional card advantage and flexibility. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game while chipping away at the opponent's life total with efficient creatures.
